new_destinations.name: Tennant Creek
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Tennant Creek' city article (See/Do sections list the Telegraph Station, Pebbles, Lake Mary Ann, Nyinkka Nyunyu); NT tourism 'Tennant Creek and Barkly region' destinations chapter and top-10 things to do around Tennant Creek.
new_destinations.note: Five kept spots within 13 km of the centre; 22 km reach. Centre is Wikipedia's rounded town point: refine with resolve-pin (place=town). Rank 5 (regional hub and gateway); owner may lift to 4. Barkly Tableland (Wikivoyage region) was weighed as the destination instead: its land is a vast cattle plain whose only visitor sights are the Stuart Highway stops 100-280 km away, no span could hold them, and travellers say 'Tennant Creek'; the Tableland is described in the destination text, not made a destination or spot.

placements.name: Tennant Creek Telegraph Station
placements.coordinates_source: wikivoyage:Tennant_Creek listing (own geo tag) - agrees with Wikipedia article title; confirm with resolve-pin
placements.bio: An 1872 stone Overland Telegraph station 10 km north of town, with a self-guided walk through the original buildings.
placements.reason: About 11 km from the Tennant Creek centre, inside the 22 km reach and visited from the town. 3 counted sources, 435 views.

placements.name: Nyinkka Nyunyu Art and Culture Centre
placements.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage listing with its own geo tag; confirm with resolve-pin
placements.bio: A Warumungu cultural centre in town with art, interpretive exhibits and stories of the local Aboriginal people.
placements.reason: In the town centre. 2 counted sources, 0 views.

placements.name: Battery Hill Mining Centre
placements.coordinates_source: osm:tourism=museum (Battery Hill Mining Centre), resolve-pin HIGH (from candidates.json)
placements.bio: A gold-mining heritage centre with an underground tour and Australia's last working ten-head stamp battery.
placements.reason: On the edge of town. 1 counted source (NT tourism top-10), 0 views.

placements.name: The Pebbles
placements.coordinates_source: wikivoyage:Tennant_Creek listing (Kunjarra The Pebbles) with own geo tag; confirm with resolve-pin
placements.bio: A small field of granite boulders, known to the Warumungu as Kunjarra, a women's dancing site 10 km north of town.
placements.reason: About 13 km from the centre, inside the reach. 2 counted sources, 3135 views.

placements.name: Lake Mary Ann
placements.bio: A 1980 dam lake 5 km north of town for swimming, canoeing and picnics, with a walking track into the Honeymoon Ranges.
placements.reason: About 5 km from the centre. 3 counted sources, 733 views.

placements.name: Devils Marbles
placements.coordinates_source: wikivoyage:Barkly_Tableland listing (Devils Marbles Conservation Reserve); reserve-level point, not a visitor point
placements.wiki: Karlu Karlu / Devils Marbles Conservation Reserve
placements.bio: Granite boulders balanced on one another along the Stuart Highway, a sacred Warumungu site with a walking path and camping.
placements.reason: About 105 km south of Tennant Creek, far outside any span, reached on its own along the Stuart Highway; standalone flagship stop (the area's headline sight, 14079 views, 3 counted sources). Not a destination: one place, not four spots round a base.

placements.name: Iytwelepenty / Davenport Range National Park
placements.coordinates_source: wikipedia park centre (centroid, not a visitor point)
placements.bio: A remote national park of rugged ranges east of the Stuart Highway, with 4WD tracks, permanent waterholes and rock wallabies.
placements.reason: About 80 km south-east of Tennant Creek by long 4WD tracks, outside the span. It is a national park but has one kept spot (its waterhole is in review), so it does not clear the four-spot bar and stands alone. 4 counted sources, 704 views.

placements.name: Wycliffe Well
placements.bio: A Stuart Highway roadhouse and caravan park that calls itself the UFO capital of Australia, with sighting logs and alien-themed decor.
placements.reason: About 125 km south of Tennant Creek on the highway, 25 km south of Devils Marbles; not part of any span and a separate stop. 2 counted sources, 6947 views.

placements.name: Barrow Creek Telegraph Station
placements.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Barrow Creek Telegraph Station (3 decimals checked: 5-6 decimals); confirm with resolve-pin
placements.bio: An 1872 stone Overland Telegraph station reserve on the Stuart Highway with a self-guided walk through the original buildings.
placements.reason: About 205 km south of Tennant Creek, nearer Alice Springs than any base; standalone. Distinct from Tennant Creek Telegraph Station (different site). 1 counted source (NT Government), 1475 views.

placements.name: Newcastle Waters
placements.bio: A drovers' ghost town off the Stuart Highway with preserved Jones's Store and Junction Hotel and a drovers' memorial park.
placements.reason: About 280 km north of Tennant Creek and 5 hours from any destination; standalone. 1 counted source, 4579 views.

placements.name: Anmatjere Man
placements.coordinates_source: none yet: resolve-pin needed at Aileron Roadhouse (do not use the Aileron locality point)
placements.bio: A 12 m steel-and-cement sculpture of an Anmatjere man beside the Stuart Highway at Aileron.
placements.reason: Aileron is about 135 km north of Alice Springs and about 600 km from Tennant Creek: it sits in the Alice Springs and Red Centre region, so this is a standalone stop. If the Alice region pass proposes it, merge. 1 counted source, 0 views.

folded.name: Barkly Tableland
folded.disposition: not a spot or destination: a region of cattle country (judge rejected as a place; skeptic kept as a name candidate). Used as description/name_evidence context for Tennant Creek. Kept place is not lost: its Wikivoyage region page supplies the sights placed here.

neighbour_check.why_not_a_spot: Over 100 km, past the 22 km reach; reached by highway as its own stop.
Remote 4WD range outside the 30 km span, not a town excursion.

neighbour_check.note: No standalone spot lies within 40 km of Tennant Creek's centre.

notes: Reviews are held for the owner, not placed. Pins: every Wikipedia/Wikivoyage point must be re-resolved with resolve-pin before apply; Anmatjere Man has none. Davenport and Devils Marbles points are reserve-level.
